summary: Security review of phase_base 562c5800..audited_head 128b6c12 (HEAD confirmed current at 128b6c125b625a5920d5baedbe524fb1b37fc02c). Applicability: applicable; the diff changes the paid-provider spend guard. Empirical probes in a scratch copy (empty HOME, no key, no provider call) confirm: (RB-1, Blocker) scanCostFiles reads <unitRoot>/<anyDirectChild>/muse/costs.tsv, so the new cards/muse/costs.tsv counts toward the restart cap of 1.00 USD; a restart call with 0.50 USD of restart-only spend was refused because 0.60 USD of card spend leaked in (spend 1.10). This contradicts the module contract at storytime-muse-guards.mjs:38-39 and freezes all restart calls once card spend reaches ~0.99 USD. (RB-2, Major) isCardSpec is an exact string match while writes follow resolve(ROOT, spec.outDir); a cards/muse2 variant passed both guards with 5.00 USD unscanned (refused=false, spend=0). (RB-3, Major) the spend guard checks once per invocation before a pool of up to 31 provider calls; the orchestrator routes it to Green as a Phase 1 FIX because the owner order is 'stop at 1.60 USD'. (RB-4 to RB-6, Nits) negative cost cells, no path containment, key-typo fallback. Verified good: guard before readKey and before any provider call, mixed-call refusal before any scan, --tries counted, clean secret scan of the diff (no key, token, or credential patterns), no test reads the real env file, A2 not applicable, no A6 overstatement in tracks.md.
blocking_findings: RB-1 [Blocker] review-b: The restart scan counts card spend. scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:176-191 scanCostFiles reads <unitRoot>/<anyChild>/muse/costs.tsv and <child>/muse/elements/costs.tsv; since this phase created out/storytime/l2/unit1/cards/muse, every card row counts toward SPEND_CAP_USD 1.00 with RESTART_START 2026-11-04T07:54:00Z. Rationale: probe A shows a restart call with 0.50 USD restart-only spend refused (spend 1.10) solely because card rows leak in. This contradicts the module contract at storytime-muse-guards.mjs:38-39 ('the restart cap never counts card spend'), answers the phase question 'can a card call use or change the restart budget' with yes, and freezes all restart calls (the approved 'redo the incorrect pictures' work) once card spend reaches ~0.99 USD. It fails closed (no overspend), so the fix is cheap: exclude the 'cards' child (or scope to week folders) in scanCostFiles and pin it with a test. Disposition: FIX for Green.
nonblocking_findings: RB-2 [Major] review-b: An outDir variant escapes both cost scans. scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:54 classifies by exact string equality, but scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:54-55 resolves and writes to spec.outDir without containment. Rationale: probe B shows a cards/muse2 variant classified restart with 5.00 USD of spend visible to no scan (refused=false, spend=0); trailing-slash and dot-dot variants are also non-card. A trailing-slash call is refused only because of the RB-1 coupling (probe B7), so fixing RB-1 without constraining outDir reopens this hole. test-strategy.md:221 and :418 anticipate this edge and route it to Green. Disposition: FIX for Green (validate the resolved outDir against the scanned layout for the call's class, or refuse unknown locations).

RB-3 [Major] review-b: The spend guard checks once per invocation, then scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:408 runs a pool of up to 31 provider calls (concurrency 4) against that single pre-call value. Rationale: the owner order is 'stop at 1.60 USD' (sum plus margin before a call, storytime-muse-guards.mjs:7-8); a batch starting at spend 1.59 under cap 1.60 can overshoot by the whole batch cost (~0.62 at ~0.02 per card) because no call re-checks the guard and concurrent calls share one gate value. Disposition: FIX for Green in Phase 1 (re-check the spend guard before each provider call inside the worker loop), per the orchestrator answer; not deferred.

RB-4 [Nit] review-b: parseCostsTsv (storytime-muse-guards.mjs:133) keeps negative cost cells (Number(x) || 0 preserves -k) which reduce spendTotal, and sinceStart (lines 140-141) silently excludes rows whose time does not parse. Rationale: a corrupted or hand-edited costs.tsv undercounts spend; test-strategy.md:418 calls a negative cost row a trusted-file note case. Disposition: note; clamp negatives to 0 if hardening is wanted.

RB-5 [Nit] review-b: No containment check on spec.outDir, spec.references, or import --color/--line (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:54-55, 77, 336-345). Rationale: a hand-crafted spec could write outside the repo or send an out-of-repo image to the provider; all 31 in-repo specs are pinned safe by CS4/CS6/CS9. Disposition: note; add a containment check if the tool ever runs untrusted specs.

RB-6 [Nit] review-b: readKey accepts the misspelled OPERNROUTER_API_KEY fallback (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:41). Rationale: pre-existing, harmless, but it can mask an env file that holds only the typo name. Disposition: note.
evidence: HEAD check: git rev-parse HEAD = 128b6c125b625a5920d5baedbe524fb1b37fc02c, equal to audited_head_sha and role_base_sha; the audit is current.

Probe A (scratch, pure runGuards): unitRoot with w01/muse/costs.tsv 0.50 USD (2026-11-04) and cards/muse/costs.tsv 0.60 USD (2026-11-06); restart call returned refused=true, spend=1.1, message 'refused: spend 1.1000 USD plus 0.01 over cap 1'; card call on the same root returned spend=0.6, refused=false (card reads only card files).

Probe B (scratch, pure runGuards + isCardCall): exact outDir is a card call; trailing-slash, cards/muse2, and dot-dot outDirs are not; cards/muse2 with a 5.00 USD row returned refused=false, spend=0, run='restart'; trailing-slash call with 1.10 USD in cards/muse was refused only via the restart scan (run='restart', spend=1.1).

Probe C (CLI in scratch, empty HOME without env file): over-cap-boundary card call (1.59 + 0.01) passed the guard and failed at readKey with ENOENT, matching the pinned margin semantics of CG4 (1.595 refuses); the variant outDir was created by loadSpec; no costs.tsv was written without a provider call.

Guard order: scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:400 calls runGuards and exits 3 on refusal before readKey at line 407 and before the pool at line 408; tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts:144-172 (CG10) asserts no 'no key' output at exit 3 under an empty HOME; the mixed refusal at scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:223-233 returns before any cost scan.

Restart contract: the card direction is intact (probe A card call reads only card files; restart values byte-equal per CG2), and a restart call cannot claim the card budget because classification needs the exact outDir string; the only leaks are card-to-restart (RB-1) and unscanned variants (RB-2).

--tries: requested tries are counted in tryGuard (storytime-muse-guards.mjs:156-162,248); NaN or negative --tries pass the guard but doLine reserves no files (storytime-muse.mjs:245), so no calls and no spend result.

API key: readKey (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:34-45) runs only after a passed guard; the key flows only into the Authorization header (line 87) and is never printed, logged, or written; no test reads the real env file (CG10 writes its own empty fake env at tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts:150-151 in a temp HOME).
Secret scan: git diff 562c5800..128b6c12 | grep -inE "api[_-]?key|secret|token|bearer|sk-[a-z0-9]{8}|password|credential" printed nothing (exit 1); no key, token, or credential material was added.

A2: not applicable; no draft-to-published flip exists in this diff (test-strategy.md:300). A6: measure/tracks.md lists this track as [~] in progress and claims no resolved security state; the only overstatement is the code comment at storytime-muse-guards.mjs:38-39, which RB-1 falsifies.

In-repo specs: all 31 card specs pin outDir === CARD_RUN.outDir and in-repo relative references (tests/storytime-card-specs.test.ts:55,104-118; CS9 mutation test), so the committed run path is safe; RB-2 needs a crafted spec.
